issues: The statement "Fundamental Theorem of Algebra guarantees that a polynomial of degree n has at most n real zeroes (counting multiplicities)" is slightly imprecise. The Fundamental Theorem of Algebra guarantees n complex roots (counting multiplicities); the number of real zeroes is at most n but this is not a direct guarantee of the theorem. Consider revising to: "The Fundamental Theorem of Algebra guarantees n complex roots (counting multiplicities); consequently a polynomial of degree n can have at most n real zeroes."
